instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 21 Spring Boot app built with Maven.
- pom.xml at project root
- Port 8080
output:
FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY pom.xml .
RUN mvn dependency:go-offline
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn package -DskipTests

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/target/*.jar app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 17 app using sdkman to install a specific Java version.
- Port 8080
output:
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl zip unzip
RUN curl -s "https://get.sdkman.io" | bash
ENV SDKMAN_DIR="/root/.sdkman"
RUN ["/bin/bash", "-c", "source $SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh && sdk install java 17.0.9-tem && sdk default java 17.0.9-tem"]
WORKDIR /app
COPY target/app.jar app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 21 app that runs as a non-root user.
- Port 8080
output:
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
RUN groupadd -r app && useradd -r -g app app
WORKDIR /app
COPY target/app.jar app.jar
RUN chown -R app:app /app
USER app
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 17 GraalVM native image build.
- Build stage compiles native image
- Final stage is slim
- Port 8080
output:
FROM ghcr.io/graalvm/graalvm-ce:21 AS builder
RUN gu install native-image
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN mvn package -DskipTests -Pnative
RUN native-image -jar target/*.jar app

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
COPY --from=builder /app/app /usr/local/bin/app
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 21 Spring Boot app with actuator health checks.
- Port 8080
- HEALTHCHECK against /actuator/health
output:
FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY pom.xml .
RUN mvn dependency:go-offline
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn package -DskipTests

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/target/*.jar app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/actuator/health || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Java 21 Spring Boot app with a layered JAR for better caching.
- Port 8080
output:
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
RUN java -Djarmode=layertools -jar app.jar extract --destination extracted
COPY --from=builder /app/extracted/dependencies/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/extracted/spring-boot-loader/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/extracted/snapshot-dependencies/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/extracted/application/ ./
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher"]
